name: Selcuk Ecza Deposu Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
summary: Selçuk Ecza Deposu Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. operates as a distribution channel between pharmaceutical manufacturers, and hospitals and pharmacies. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Selçuk Ecza Deposu Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. operstes as a subsidiary of Selçuk Ecza Holding A.S.
